title: "Encountered backfill data we don't recognise"
symptom: The user encountered a message 'Encountered backfill data we don't recognise' and suspects the sensor (G7) has failed. The sensor was 2 days old at failure. A new sensor started warming up but initially showed only 8 days of life remaining instead of 10, though it corrected to 10.5 days after about 10 minutes.
evidence_quote: Hi - seeing this, and it seems the sensor (G7) has failed.
